# Validation Fixture Repository

Deterministic repository specifically built for Devaura Phase 3.5 Code Intelligence validation, benchmark scoring, and hardening.

Contains known ground-truth relationships across Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript:
- Symbol declarations (classes, methods, functions, async functions, interfaces, type aliases)
- Direct, nested, imported, and aliased function calls
- Class inheritance hierarchies (EXTENDS)
- Internal, external, and unresolved imports
- Direct and heuristic test-to-source relationships
- Multi-tier search targets
